reason: H0 already drives the public WebP image-decoder protocol with arbitrary source bytes: fuzz constructs wuffs_webp__decoder and fuzz_image_decoder calls decode_image_config, queries workbuf_len, allocates that work buffer, then repeatedly calls decode_frame_config and decode_frame. In S1, WebP ALPH processing is reached through those same calls when input selects an 'ALPH' chunk; decoder.do_decode_frame? invokes decoder.decode_alph?, sets vp8.QUIRK_HAS_ALPHA_SIDE_CHANNEL internally, and later invokes decoder.apply_alph_chunk!. The caller-visible increased buffer requirement is represented by decoder.workbuf_len, which H0 already queries after decode_image_config. Thus H0 retains adequate input, state, configuration, and allocation control for the newly added behavior, and the new VP8 quirk is an internal WebP-to-VP8 protocol rather than a missing harness action.
evidence: fuzz passes the complete wuffs_base__io_buffer src to fuzz_image_decoder using wuffs_webp__decoder__upcast_as__wuffs_base__image_decoder.
fuzz_image_decoder calls wuffs_base__image_decoder__decode_image_config before obtaining wuffs_base__image_decoder__workbuf_len(dec).max_incl and allocating workbuf.
fuzz_image_decoder repeatedly calls wuffs_base__image_decoder__decode_frame_config and wuffs_base__image_decoder__decode_frame with that workbuf.
S1 decoder.do_decode_frame? recognizes sub_chunk_type == 'ALPH'le and directly calls this.decode_alph?(src: args.src, workbuf: args.workbuf).
S1 decoder.do_decode_frame? directly calls this.vp8.set_quirk!(key: vp8.QUIRK_HAS_ALPHA_SIDE_CHANNEL, value: 1), so H0 does not need to configure that quirk separately.
S1 decoder.workbuf_len adds width × height when quirk_has_alpha_side_channel is enabled, matching H0's existing dynamic work-buffer allocation path.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit; retain H0 and rely on ALPH-bearing WebP corpus inputs to exercise the new path.
